cases.description: 120 s iOS 48 kHz Parakeet precompute resumes on 150 s finalized .caf when 5,760,048 CAF source frames (120 s + 48-frame FIR lookahead) match while 16 kHz recognitionSampleCount (1,920,000) stays separate.
120 s iOS 48 kHz precompute at exact cassini-fir-48k-16k-v1 minimum (5,760,046 frames) resumes even when the very next unconsumed frame (5,760,046) differs.
Mutating PCM at second 130 (strictly after the 120 s + lookahead committed prefix) leaves prefixSha256 unchanged and resumes.

120 s iOS 48 kHz Whistle precompute (doneMs without separate Parakeet recognitionSampleCount) resumes when both 48 kHz CAF prefix SHA-256 (including FIR lookahead) and decoded 16 kHz PCM SHA-256 match.
120 s 16 kHz CAF source (no resampling, resamplerLookaheadFrames=0) requires 1,920,000 source frames and resumes cleanly.
Android Parakeet precompute resumes after trailing pages and EOS page are appended at Stop.
Android Whistle precompute resumes when committed Ogg bytes and decoded PCM prefix match.
Unchanged whole-file signature resumes directly without requiring prefix comparison.

Equating 48 kHz CAF committedUnitCount with 16 kHz RecognitionCheckpoint.position (1,920,000 = only 40 s of 48 kHz audio) is rejected with prefixCoverageInsufficient even when those 40 s hash identically.
Omitting the 48-frame FIR right-halo lookahead (committedUnitCount=5,760,000 < 5,760,046) is rejected with prefixCoverageInsufficient.
Finalized 48 kHz .caf truncated at second 60 (2,880,000 frames: beyond the 40 s first third, yet short of 5,760,048) -> silent discardAndFullDecode (prefixTruncated).
CAFRepair truncated finalized 48 kHz .caf by 1 frame inside the FIR lookahead tail (5,760,047 < 5,760,048) -> silent discardAndFullDecode (never CHECKPOINT_MISMATCH).
Mutating PCM at second 60 (frame 2,880,000: beyond the 40 s first third of the 120 s consumed prefix) changes prefixSha256 -> silent discardAndFullDecode.
Mutating PCM at frame 5,760,045 (the exact final source frame tapped by cassini-fir-48k-16k-v1 for y[1,919,999]) changes prefixSha256 -> silent discardAndFullDecode.
CAFRepair patched a sample inside the early committed 48 kHz PCM16LE prefix (frame 100) -> silent discardAndFullDecode.
Mismatched sourceSampleRateHz between checkpoint (48 kHz) and finalized CAF (44.1 kHz) -> silent discardAndFullDecode.
Re-encoded or header-rewritten Ogg Opus prefix changes prefixSha256 -> silent discardAndFullDecode.
API 26-28 AacCapture finalized container cannot match oggOpusCommittedBytes -> silent discardAndFullDecode.
Switching model between recording and Stop discards precompute checkpoint cleanly.
Changed Sortformer speaker-model identity discards precompute checkpoint cleanly.
Legacy checkpoint schema version 1 is rejected per D51.
Checkpoint from a different source audio file is rejected cleanly.
Whistle decoded 16 kHz PCM prefix mismatch discards precompute checkpoint cleanly.
Zero committedUnitCount is malformed and discarded cleanly.
Truncated words.log sidecar discards precompute checkpoint cleanly.
Non-precompute batch checkpoint without committedPrefix preserves rejectBatchCheckpoint on modified source.
